title: asset.save response result
description: Acknowledgement that a synchronous asset save completed. Failure is returned as an error response with code ENGINE_ASSET_EDIT_REJECTED and an English message. Its data object contains string fields 'method' (asset.save) and 'reason' (type_mismatch, out_of_range, unknown_property, unknown_asset, or save_failed), and a string 'path' field only when applicable.

saved.description: Indicates that the asset was saved successfully.
